ambiguity_effects.explain: Two users are named Dana Whitfield, differing only by the guest flag. This shows guest contractor is a required attribute, not decoration, so the loose name-only reading is one a careful reader should reject. It does change which record matches if someone applied that loose reading.
Linear issues have a single creator field, so both readings converge on the same field; i-it-sso-d fails because the email itself differs, not because of the reading chosen.
